summary: The blind compare flagged one item: 034 was ambiguous because 颜色太重 is accepted colloquially for a dark colour, so the 重 distractor was swapped for 高. A full read found four more defects: a vulgar-slang distractor (打飞机) in 022, an unnatural time in 031, an unnatural clause in 086 and a gendered English cue in 072. Judgement calls left as they are: 093 keeps 大 as a distractor for 印象 (很深的印象 is standard), and 063 keys 系 over 戴 for 安全带.

collocations-02-034.note: Blind AMBIGUOUS: 颜色太重 is common colloquial for 'too dark'. Replaced distractor 重 with 高; why updated.

collocations-02-022.note: Removed distractor 打: 打飞机 is vulgar slang, not a harmless wrong option. Now three options; why updated.

collocations-02-031.note: 七点才起床 reads oddly (seven is not late); changed to 九点. en and py updated.

collocations-02-072.note: English assumed the neighbour's gender ('he'); made neutral.

collocations-02-086.note: Second clause 不要小声说话 was unnatural; replaced with 每天早上. en and py updated.
